metadata.question: Does the active fire presence in La Palma, Spain decrease in July 17-18, 2023 compared to July 15-16, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Fire product: MODIS FIRMS active‐fire detections (MOD14/MYD14) which are delivered as a FeatureCollection: “FIRMS/‌VIIRS/” datasets (SUOMI and NOAA-20). The nearest daily layer is “FIRMS/‌VIIRS/‌NOAA20/‌NRT/‌VEARLY”. Its DateTime field “YYYYMMDD” goes back to 2022. (MODIS is weekly in Earth Engine). - Dates: Compare 15-16 July 2023 (period1) vs 17-18 July 2023 (period2). - Location: La Palma island (Canarias). Bounding box used in literature ~ -17.95 W to -17.75 W, 28.52 N to 28.70 N. 2. Masking / cleaning: None needed. Each feature is one confident fire pixel (FRP > 0 is required by FIRMS). 3. Logic to distinguish valid zero vs null: - If either selected FeatureCollection size() is 0, it is a valid zero (no fires detected). - The script prints counts (“Fires period1”, “Fires period2”) first. - A decrease means count_p1 > count_p2. If equal, it is “No decrease” → answer B. - If any collection is empty because no images exist (unlikely here), output C1; if collection is None or reducer gives Null, output C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry la_palma = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(-17.95, 28.52, -17.75, 28.70) # 2. Data def fire_feats(d1, d2): return ee.FeatureCollection('FIRMS/VIIRS/NOAA20/NRT/VEARLY') \ .filterDate(d1, d2).filterBounds(la_palma) p1 = fire_feats('2023-07-15', '2023-07-17') # 15-16 inclusive p2 = fire_feats('2023-07-17', '2023-07-19') # 17-18 inclusive # sizes n1 = p1.size().getInfo() n2 = p2.size().getInfo() print(f"Fire pixels 15-16 Jul 2023: {n1}") print(f"Fire pixels 17-18 Jul 2023: {n2}") if n1 is None or n2 is None: print("C3") elif n1 > n2: # fewer on second period (decrease) print("A") else: # equal or increase print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry
la_palma = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(-17.95, 28.52, -17.75, 28.70)

# 2. Data
def fire_feats(d1, d2):
    return ee.FeatureCollection('FIRMS/VIIRS/NOAA20/NRT/VEARLY') \
               .filterDate(d1, d2).filterBounds(la_palma)

p1 = fire_feats('2023-07-15', '2023-07-17')  # 15-16 inclusive
p2 = fire_feats('2023-07-17', '2023-07-19')  # 17-18 inclusive

# sizes
n1 = p1.size().getInfo()
n2 = p2.size().getInfo()

print(f"Fire pixels 15-16 Jul 2023: {n1}")
print(f"Fire pixels 17-18 Jul 2023: {n2}")

if n1 is None or n2 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif n1 > n2:  # fewer on second period (decrease)
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:  # equal or increase
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
